episodes.prompt: Orion had brief p95 latency spikes around 14:04 on three nonadjacent days, followed by a production outage. Investigate the cause by reading /workspace/history/orion-batch.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Orion incident review

A 14:00 reporting batch began the same week. Database lock-wait traces rose within four minutes of each run. Disabling the batch eliminated the spikes in a controlled replay; re-enabling it reproduced them. The incident review closed on batch contention as root cause.

episodes.prompt: Vega showed short queue stalls near 02:00 on several nights. Investigate by reading /workspace/history/vega-batch.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Vega incident review

A nightly 02:00 compaction workload had been moved onto the same storage pool. I/O saturation aligned with each stall. Moving compaction to 03:30 stopped the stalls for the next 14 nights. The investigation concluded scheduled-workload contention was causal.

episodes.prompt: Cedar's release tracker said a required migration rehearsal was still scheduled even though the release owner reported no blockers. Investigate by reading /workspace/history/cedar-stale.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Cedar release review

The migration rehearsal actually ran Wednesday at 16:30 and passed. The release tracker was not refreshed afterward. Deployment logs and the rehearsal receipt both confirm completion. The apparent blocker was stale metadata, not an incomplete rehearsal.

episodes.prompt: Nova's operations dashboard still showed a high queue-depth warning after the incident commander said the backlog was cleared. Investigate by reading /workspace/history/nova-stale.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Nova dashboard review

Direct queue telemetry showed normal depth within two minutes of remediation. The dashboard cache refreshed only every 30 minutes and continued rendering the old warning. The apparent ongoing incident was stale presentation state.

episodes.prompt: Aurora showed lower CPU utilization after a traffic increase. Investigate by reading /workspace/history/aurora-capacity.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Aurora capacity review

Autoscaling added two application replicas 12 minutes before traffic increased. Total CPU consumption rose, but per-instance utilization fell. The lower percentage reflected increased capacity rather than a fault.

episodes.prompt: Mercury's certificate inventory showed two different renewal dates. Investigate by reading /workspace/history/mercury-cert.md. Give the resolved conclusion and what evidence changed the initial interpretation.
episodes.support:
# Mercury certificate review

The service uses separate edge and origin certificates. The two dates refer to different certificates and both are correct. No contradiction or operational issue exists.
